description:
"Encase an enemy in molten rock, reducing their movement speed by |cffffff50|r% for |cffffff1|r second. Upon completion, the target is stunned for |cffffff4|r seconds, or |cffffff8|r seconds against monsters.

This stun cannot be blocked.

The molten rock melts through the enemy's armor and applies Minor Breach for |cffffff10|r seconds, reducing Armor by |cffffff2974|r."
